reason: Ten complete development observations produced zero selected trades and no economically adequate fee capture. Preserve evidence and shift research to wallet-derived strategy discovery rather than retuning the legacy rule.
rules: Do not resume 60-second development collection while status is research_hold.
Do not freeze or tune a rule from the ten legacy observations.
Do not lower the 350000-lamport cost hurdle to manufacture qualification.
Wallet-derived research must use a cohort frozen before PnL analysis.
Any future candidate strategy must be derived from the frozen wallet study and then tested prospectively on post-freeze data.
